mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_orderparameter ( user_id, numbers, box_number, series_id, spirit_power, activity_type, point_deduction, coupon_deduction, order_amount, payment_amount, ids, business_type, out_trade_no, wx_order_no ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{numbers, typeHandler=com.qiguliuxing.dts.db.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{boxNumber}, #{seriesId}, #{spiritPower}, #{activityType}, #{pointDeduction}, #{couponDeduction}, #{orderAmount}, #{paymentAmount}, #{ids, typeHandler=com.qiguliuxing.dts.db.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler}, #{businessType}, #{outTradeNo}, #{wxOrderNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, CAST(numbers AS CHAR) as numbers, box_number as boxNumber, series_id as seriesId, spirit_power as spiritPower, activity_type as activityType, point_deduction as pointDeduction, coupon_deduction as couponDeduction, order_amount as orderAmount, payment_amount as paymentAmount, CAST(ids AS CHAR) as ids, business_type as businessType, out_trade_no as outTradeNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, wx_order_no as wxOrderNo FROM wx_orderparameter WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}

SELECT id, user_id as userId, numbers, box_number as boxNumber, series_id as seriesId, spirit_power as spiritPower, activity_type as activityType, point_deduction as pointDeduction, coupon_deduction as couponDeduction, order_amount as orderAmount, payment_amount as paymentAmount, ids, business_type as businessType, out_trade_no as outTradeNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime,wx_order_no as wxOrderNo FROM wx_orderparameter WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
